reviews.text: Ruined by move to pricey subscription model. This was a great app until recent updates (labeled as ”bug fixes” in the version history) moved many of the sounds, and the ability to play in the background/when the phone is locked, behind a $25/yr paywall, without warning. I’d have been happy to pay a few dollars to help the developer out but can’t fathom a subscription model, much less at that price, for a minimalist app that shouldn’t require much updating at all. Feels like a money grab. Uninstalling.
